READABILITY.evidence: The names reveal intent (noncePrefix, flushChunk, readChunk, decodeKey) and the code is gofmt-ed. The package doc lays out the stream format, exported functions have doc comments, and the nonce-construction logic is commented.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: Crypto is split into config.go and encryption.go, and the functions are short. The key check is shared through checkKey/newGCM, and Validate uses a table of required/allowed fields instead of copy-pasted branches. One deviation: it uses argon2 rather than the pbkdf2 the project context suggested, but that is still in x/crypto, so no new module.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: Errors are wrapped with %w ErrInvalidKey, and writer errors stick in ew.err. Chunk lengths are bounds-checked (length < nonceSize+tagSize || > maxChunkLen), and EOF becomes ErrUnexpectedEOF so truncation errors. HMAC uses hmac.Equal, and constants and argon2 parameters are named.

C7-13-CASE1.evidence: Only the required changes were made: EnsureFileName(filename, job.Gzip, job.Encrypted(), job.Unique), Job.Validate exported, Encryption field added. storage.go passes the new parameter, PathGenerator keeps its signature, and the existing P2P tests pass, so unencrypted output is unchanged.
